```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - '.agents/skills/anim/**'
      - 'packages/lib/motion-presets.ts'
      - 'packages/lib/motion.tsx'
      - 'packages/ui/**'
      - 'apps/donor/**'
      - 'apps/missionary/**'
      - 'apps/admin/**'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine Code Owner
        id: owner
        run: |
          # Simple heuristic: check CODEOWNERS for matching paths
          # In a real scenario, you might use a more robust tool or API
          OWNER="asymmetric-al/core"
          
          # Check if specific paths are touched to assign specific owners if needed
          # For this example, we default to the repo owner or a specific team
          if grep -q "packages/lib" .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null; then
            OWNER="asymmetric-al/core"
          fi
          
          echo "owner=$OWNER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment on PR to notify Code Owner
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const owner = '${{ steps.owner.outputs.owner }}';
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            
            const body = `
            ### 🤖 Codex Review Notification
            
            @${owner} This PR contains changes related to **anim-aligned motion presets**, **UX polish**, and **skill mirrors**.
            
            **Key Areas of Impact:**
            - \`@asym/lib/motion-presets\`
            - \`@asym/lib/motion\`
            - UI Components (Donor, Missionary, Admin)
            - Skill Mirrors (`.agents/skills/anim`)
            
            Please review the implementation of reduced-motion awareness, hover/tap scales, and token alignment.
            `;

            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: prNumber,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: body
            });
```
